PHYSICAL EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

2. Best practice when working on High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique.
   B. Refuse all feedback on High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique.
   C. Damage equipment used for High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique.
   D. Practise High Jump ● Fosbury flop technique with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hockey Playing skills ● Passing ● Dribbling ● Hitting ● Stopping ● Marking and D and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
